text: The buyer changed their mind: how does the money go back to the card?
prefix: The buyer changed their mind: how does the money go back to the card?

text: There are two ways, and the day decides: before the scheme settles the day's payments, or after.
prefix: There are two ways, and the day decides: before the scheme settles the day's payments, or after.

text: On the day it was paid, the debit is reversed: Uzcard reverses the transaction, and Humo cancels it, as if it never happened.
prefix: On the day it was paid, the debit is reversed: Uzcard reverses the transaction, and Humo cancels it, as if it never happened.

text: Later, it is refunded: Uzcard reverses it all the same, and Humo returns the payment.
prefix: Later, it is refunded: Uzcard reverses it all the same, and Humo returns the payment.

text: Which day it is, is read in the settlement time zone, Tashkent, from configuration.
prefix: Which day it is, is read in the settlement time zone, Tashkent, from configuration.

text: A refund is allowed only within the website's refund window, set when the bank switched it on.
prefix: A refund is allowed only within the website's refund window, set when the bank switched it on.

text: Both schemes give back the whole payment, so the whole amount goes back, never a part.
prefix: Both schemes give back the whole payment, so the whole amount goes back, never a part.

text: One conditional update claims it: paid becomes returning, and only one caller wins.
prefix: One conditional update claims it: paid becomes returning, and only one caller wins.

text: The operation is written to the journal before the scheme is asked, with the scheme's own id for the debit.
prefix: The operation is written to the journal before the scheme is asked, with the scheme's own id for the debit.

text: Approved is final, reversed or refunded; refused leaves it paid; and no answer leaves it returning for a person, never sent twice.
prefix: Approved is final, reversed or refunded; refused leaves it paid; and no answer leaves it returning for a person, never sent twice.
